<analysis>JpaResultMapper.list(Query, Class) of QLRM 1.7.1 (ch.simas.qlrm:qlrm) is compiled against javax.persistence.Query; the code passes a jakarta.persistence.Query now. QLRM moved to the org.qlrm groupId and to Jakarta Persistence in 4.x (same org.qlrm.mapper package). The script replaces the dependency with org.qlrm:qlrm:4.2.1 in every pom that declares the old one (scope kept).</analysis>
<script>
OLD = ("ch.simas.qlrm", "qlrm")
NEW = ("org.qlrm", "qlrm", "4.2.1")


def fix(p):
    for path in p.files("**/pom.xml"):
        pom = p.pom(path)
        if not pom.has_dependency(*OLD):
            continue
        scope = next((d.get("scope") for d in pom.dependencies()
                      if (d.get("group_id"), d.get("artifact_id")) == OLD), None)
        pom.remove_dependency(*OLD)
        if not pom.has_dependency(NEW[0], NEW[1]):
            pom.add_dependency(NEW[0], NEW[1], NEW[2], scope=scope)
        pom.save()
        p.log(f"{path}: ch.simas.qlrm:qlrm -> org.qlrm:qlrm:4.2.1 (jakarta)")
</script>
